description: Take over a Pipedrive deal pipeline (pipeline_id → its stages, objekt_typ 'deal') or a Pipedrive project board (board_id → its phases, objekt_typ 'project') as a workflow. Idempotent: re-import updates names/order and keeps agent_info, triggers and done-conditions you added. Optional verzweigungen: [{vor:<stage id>, zweige:[{knoten:<stage id>, feld:'Experte', wert:'Erika'} | {knoten, bedingung}], danach?:<stage id>}] — e.g. SCHEDULED → ERIKA/MAX by the deal field Experte → DONE; field names are resolved to Pipedrive field keys and option ids. kanten_neu=true rebuilds edges (default only on first import). Objects already in the pipeline appear in the workflow with the next sync (every 5 min) WITHOUT firing triggers.

kanten_neu.description: true rebuilds the edges; by default only on first import

verzweigungen.description: Branches by deal field: [{vor, zweige:[{knoten, feld, wert} | {knoten, bedingung}], danach?}]

zuruecksetzen.description: Rule for moving objects back in the workflow

name: import_pipedrive_workflow
